Security Lockdown.name: Security Lockdown
Security Lockdown.description: The user triggers U.A.'s security protocol from a faculty terminal or radio: barriers drop, gates seal, staff are paged and students are sent to shelter points. Until a teacher lifts the alert, nobody enters or leaves the sealed grounds or building without a faculty ID or a Quirk that passes through walls, unless the system has been sabotaged. Cost: none.
